Triple reverse: reverse all, reverse first k, reverse last n-k. O(n) time, O(1) space.

```python
def rotate(nums, k):
    k = k % len(nums)
    nums.reverse()
    nums[:k] = reversed(nums[:k])
    nums[k:] = reversed(nums[k:])
    return nums
```
